resume: Game OST * "I'm Neptune! I'm the CPU of Planeptune!" Neptune (ネプテューヌ Neputyūnu) (born on December 12th, 2000) is the human form of Purple Heart, the CPU of Planeptune, and also the main protagonist in Hyperdimension Neptunia. She loses her memory after a terrible fight and is banished to Gamindustri.
